scope: Source-bound native Python Workflow orchestration and pure recovery argument preparation

source_cases.preparation: Reuse complete shared Workflow cases, recipes, coverage and source witness search with Python owned-value witnesses; retain every declared occurrence and selected recovery dependency
source_cases.capacity: Existing whole-suite witness, case and byte limits remain not_evaluable boundaries, never a passing prefix

native_boundaries.receipts: Apply Python INVALID_COMMIT_RECEIPT before deriving observation and recovery hashes; do not import TypeScript exception mechanics
native_boundaries.execution: One isolated semantic process; deterministic deferred in-memory begin/read/commit/rollback ports; preserve exact Operation order and no overlapping or prematurely settled effects
native_boundaries.cancellation: Replay reachable port failures for each source occurrence using native CancelledError
native_boundaries.capture: Schedule through first suspension before mutating caller input, execution identity and dependency references
native_boundaries.integrity: Frozen detached result, observation, recovery and effect values; unchanged caller/read data except intentional capture probes; zero coercion
native_boundaries.observation: Independent whole Workflow and materialization AST observers plus exact Operation and Event dependency observation; enclosing verifier owns workspace custody
native_boundaries.mutants: Three binding immutability controls and two compiling substitutions covering orchestration and materialization

recovery: Honor existing dependency semantics and tie break; compensation calls remain inert prepared bindings, never executed or published
claim_ceiling: Finite candidate evidence only, not production transaction guarantees, arbitrary Python equivalence, execution authority, or full CLI qualification
